grain_rationale: The profile reports row_count=13014 and duplicate_row_rate=0.0, so no exact duplicate rows exist. airport_code carries 3 distinct values and observed_hour_utc carries 4341 distinct hourly timestamps; their product (3 x 4341 = 13023) is close to the actual row_count of 13014, indicating each row is a distinct station-hour observation rather than an aggregate. This supports grain_type=transaction with an identity derived from airport_code and observed_hour_utc; since duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, the identity tuple does not need to absorb any duplicates.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: Three-letter airport code identifying the weather station (distinct_values EWR, JFK, LGA; 3 distinct, no nulls across 13014 rows).

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the observation sampled on the hour (samples 2013-01-01T06:00:00 through 2013-01-01T15:00:00; 4341 distinct values, no nulls), the event time for this fact.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date of the observation (samples 2013-01-01 through 2013-01-10; 181 distinct values, no nulls), a date label alongside the UTC event timestamp.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour-of-day from 0 to 23 (24 distinct values, no nulls), a time-of-day label rather than a quantity to aggregate.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in Fahrenheit ranging 10.94 to 93.92 across 130 distinct values with no nulls, a measured quantity compared across observations.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dew point temperature in Fahrenheit ranging -9.94 to 73.94 across 119 distinct values with no nulls, a measured quantity.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage ranging 12.74 to 100.0 across 2178 distinct values with no nulls, a measured quantity.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in degrees 0 to 360 across 37 distinct values, nullable with a 1.68% null rate (219 of 13014 rows), likely when calm or unrecorded wind direction occurs.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in mph ranging 0.0 to 1048.36058 across 36 distinct values, nullable with a very low 0.0154% null rate (2 rows), a measured quantity.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in mph ranging 16.11092 to 62.14212 across 35 distinct values, nullable with a high 74.55% null rate (9702 rows), likely recorded only when a gust event occurs.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation in inches ranging 0.0 to 1.06 across 50 distinct values with no nulls, a measured quantity.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars ranging 983.8 to 1038.4 across 430 distinct values, nullable with an 11.5% null rate (1496 rows), likely when the pressure sensor reading is unavailable.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility in miles, one of 20 distinct values ranging 0.0 to 10.0, with no nulls, a measured quantity.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full airport name (John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport; 3 distinct values, no nulls), a descriptive label.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Municipality hosting the airport (New York, Newark; 2 distinct values, no nulls), a descriptive location label.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Airport elevation in feet (distinct_values 13, 18, 21; 3 distinct, no nulls), a static airport attribute rather than an event measure.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length in feet (distinct_values 7002, 11000, 14511; 3 distinct, no nulls), a static airport attribute rather than an event measure.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Pipeline capture timestamp (3 distinct values clustered at 2026-09-02T23:26:11 through 23:26:13, no nulls), recording when the row entered the pipeline rather than the business event time.

category_description: Each row is one hourly weather observation recorded at one of three New York area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA per the profiled distinct_values), carrying temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, and visibility readings for that station-hour.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_airport_weather table enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category, naming the time column, grain, identity, and field roles consumed by the deterministic modeling engine that generates the gold models; nothing here executes on its own.
usage: The modeling engine reads this contract to generate the gold fact and any dimensional references; the rendered draft is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema and gated by the validator and datacontract lint before a human reviews and approves it.
limitations: This mapping does not filter or exclude rows, including the 74.55% of rows with a null wind_gust_mph, the 11.5% with a null pressure_mb, or the 1.68% with a null wind_dir_degrees; handling of those nulls, any quality rules, and the circular averaging behavior of wind_dir_degrees are left to downstream consumers and review, not declared here.
